'''''Fighter Study''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The painting depicted an artist's sketch of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Fighter Study'' was a painting that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The image used for the painting is a piece of concept art created for the game's first expansion, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']]. The painting was one of nine paintings given out randomly to players of the game for the game's first anniversary of release in the United States and Europe. The painting was later added to the "rare loot system" in ''Hotfix 17.10'' on [[October 7]], [[2010]]. The system allowed players to loot rare items from any enemy in the game. The ship depicted seems to combine design aspects of several different ships, including the [[Kihraxz assault fighter]] and the [[M22-T Krayt gunship]]. The player could use the painting in their house as decoration.
